title: Electric Car Capital Allowances: 100% Tax Relief Ends 31 March 2027
description: The 100% First-Year Allowance on new electric cars is due to end on 31 March 2027. From 1 April 2027, relief drops to 12% a year.
author: Maria Sagastume
imageAlt: 100% first-year tax relief on new electric cars delivered before 1 April 2027, then 12% a year

stats.label: First-Year Allowance on a new electric car today
When the 100% relief is scheduled to end
Writing Down Allowance per annum from 1 April 2027

html:
Businesses can currently claim 100% tax relief on the cost of purchasing a brand-new, unused electric car (with 0g/km CO2 emissions) in the year of purchase through the First-Year Allowance (FYA). However, this relief is currently scheduled to end on 31 March 2027. From this date, Writing Down Allowances (WDA) will be applied to qualifying expenditure on new electric cars.

From 1 April 2027, the WDA rate applicable to new, unused electric cars will be 12% per annum.

Thinking of buying an electric car through your business?

If you are considering purchasing a brand-new, unused electric car through your business, we would recommend placing an order as soon as possible. If the vehicle is delivered before 1 April 2027, it should qualify for 100% tax relief.

Example: a £50,000 electric car

Example for a £50k unused electric car (with 0g/km CO2 emissions):

Vehicle delivery dateBefore 01/04/27After 01/04/27
Relief obtained100% FYA12% WDA
Year 1£50,000£6,000
Year 2£0£5,280
Year 3£0£4,646

Benefit-in-Kind (BIK)

Please note that if the vehicle is available for personal use, a Benefit-in-Kind (BIK) charge will arise.

Fully electric company cars (0g/km CO2 emissions) currently attract a BIK rate of 4% for the 2026/27 tax year. However, this is scheduled to increase as follows:

  • 2027/28: 5%
  • 2028/29: 7%
  • 2029/30: 9%

If you would like to talk through the numbers before you order, book a free meeting with us.
